verdict.rationale: The evidence pack never mentions a universal search bar in the Ramp UI that spans transactions, vendors, and cards and leads directly into payment initiation. The nearest evidence is transaction search through the MCP and AI-agent channels and per-resource CLI search commands, which are adjacent programmatic surfaces rather than the capability the story names.

support.subject: As a finance-lead, I can search across all transactions, vendors, and cards from one universal search bar and jump straight into initiating a payment
